Finally, the game has reached 1.0. 

In the past month, the endless mode and the new heroes have been tweaked and balanced. In addition, some bugs have been fixed and some weapons have been balanced.

A journey ends and a new one begins.

notes.title: Update 0.910
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

There's a new hero: The Rogue. He can be trained to use whips that do various status effects. He can also use daggers and throwing weapons. He has other skills to support the team, like ambush which damages enemies before battle, disarm traps, haggling, scavenging and more.

Have fun

notes.title: Major update: New hero + endless mode
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just in time for Christmas, a new hero and endless mode. Some of you have played the game ALOT. I didn't expect that, so I decided to implement the endless mode earlier than planned, so you can get even more challenges.
 
But first, here's a new hero: 

[h1]The Hermit [/h1]

Blind and can't fight. Improves your animal skills and can summon powerful animals. 

This is a support class, but he can be trained to do psychological attacks on animal enemies to slow them down, or charm them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806963/f7b15aae0b32fa014d1e6f7d1c210b780a0c0d44.png[/img]

[h1]Endless mode [/h1]

You can keep your party and fight new challenges in a never ending fight fest. When  you beat the final boss, there will be a button in the lower right corner. When you click on it, the world is repopulated with new monsters and treasure. Every 10 days, a powerful boss will chase you down. Try to survive as long as possible!

notes.title: Update 0.725: Town Defense
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This month I decided to add [b]town defense[/b] in the game. I was telling myself not to do it so close to launch, but hey I just couldn't resist. 
  
Prior to this update, if a wandering mob was chasing you, you could hide in a town and it would leave you alone.
  
But now, mobs can attack you while you're in a town that you own, and you will start a battle inside of said town. It will have walls, and if you have the corresponding blueprint, you can  upgrade the walls to have a [b]gate that blocks enemies[/b]. The gate can be opened or closed with a cooldown.

The gate can be upgraded with all sorts of stuff like [b]poison attacks [/b]or [b]giant spears[/b], if you find the items which are rare. You can also upgrade it permanently with potions that gives it special abilities.

Also, walls reduce ranged damage when your units are inside them, according to the level of the walls. 

In addition, I added the ability to build towers!

[b]Arrow tower[/b]:  Long range, decent amount of ammo. 
[b]Explosive tower[/b]: does splash damage, good for groups of enemies.
[b]Flame tower[/b]: same, but more focused and powerful.

There are limited spots for towers, but they have unlimited levels. You will need the corresponding blueprints to build/upgrade them. 

Finally, you can also [b]build a moat[/b]: for now you fill it with mines that do damages to enemies.
  
Launch date will be announced soon, probably next month, so stay tuned.
  
[b]The rest: [/b]

notes.title: Roadmap to 1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hereby is the roadmap to the full launch of Rogues Don't Cry.
 
 [img]https://cdn.imgpile.com/f/oeWUSKj_xl.jpg[/img]


This is  a plan, not a promise, everything is subject to change.

The game should be in Early Access for about a year, so the 1.0 version should be out around q4 2025, after that a new roadmap for the post 1.0 updates will be published.

There are 3 main goals of Early Access:

1-polish, balance, improvements 

The core mechanics of the game are already implemented, but things need to be tweaked to reach a high level of polish and balance. This requires feedback because there are over a 100 units, skills and items, all interacting with each other.

Also, I hope the community can help me improve the localization.

2- Add the new content

The new heroes and other content/secrets will be added gradually to adjust how it all fits in with the rest of the game, and this will give some time to the community to absorb and discover the new content. 

3- Tweak the difficulty

It's hard to set the right difficulty when all the pieces are not totally in place yet, so expect some adjustments during EA. The game will be generally hard, with an accessible beginning but a tough late game and final boss.

If you want to discuss the plan, or if you have questions, you can join the Discord at : [url=https://discord.gg/B9qtzAFKW3]https://discord.gg/B9qtzAFKW3[/url]     (English only for now)

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes:
The demo for [b]Rogues Don't Cry[/b] is finally out! You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2352820/Rogues_Dont_Cry/]download it from the store page[/url].

In this demo you level up your hero, build an army, explore, find items and face a tough final boss. It's a small adventure that gives you a taste of the full version! The full version has a bigger overworld, with more objects, heroes, units, items and some town building mechanics.


[b]Tips for the demo[/b]

[list]
[*] Choose your units wisely. Axemen are good all around, swordmen are fast and deal a lot of damage, pikemen are great for supporting your front line.
 
[*] Ranged units can save you from being hurt, but they cost a lot and are less effective against fast units. 
 
[*] Animals are usually fast but they can't wear weapons or armor.
 
[*] You can use the hospital at the town to heal your units, but the more you use it, the more gold it costs. So it's better to save it for your best units.
 
[*] It's a good idea to dismiss units that are too wounded or that you don't want anymore, because they have an upkeep.
[/list]
 

Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2352820/Rogues_Dont_Cry/]Wishlist the game[/url] to know when it comes out!
